summary: Helena National Forest lookout site 16 miles NW of Helena; sources give only a 1930 date beside 'history unknown', and the FFLA list marks it gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone on the FFLA Montana list with type unknown; no source gives a removal date

events.note: Only dated item in firelookout.com's entry, which says 'history unknown'; not stated to be a build date

evidence.supports: Lewis and Clark County, Helena National Forest, land description only

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build date, builder, tower design, staffing or removal date in any source read. The 1930 date is recorded as 'other', not 'built', because the entry says 'history unknown'. Coordinates agree with 16 miles NW of Helena. Two WebSearch calls returned only Oregon Bald Butte lookouts and a Marysville-area mine, which are not this site; not used. Record kind 'unknown' matches the FFLA list, so no correction is proposed. Access, visit and staffing are left out because no source addresses them.
